# Annetta Bell

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v2 XII A Jonah Day P25](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0025), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P19](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0019)</sub>

## Appearance

Annetta Bell is a faint and small child. She has soft, delicate, fawn-hued hair that drapes over her shoulders in sleek waves.

_Sources: [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P6](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0006)_

## History

Annetta Bell became a resident of [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley) after her parents shifted their family home fifty yards north from its original location in the [Stonebridge](../codex/places.md#stonebridge) school area. Her most notable offense was eating blueberries that grew in a local graveyard. While attending school in [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley), she wrote a composition in the form of an unexpectedly romantic letter that she had copied from old love letters.

_Sources: [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P6](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0006), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P0](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0000), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P8](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0008), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P9](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0009), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P26](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0026), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P38](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0038)_

## Relationships

### [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/annetta-bell--nell-harcourt.md)

Annetta is a pupil in Nell's schoolroom. When [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) decides to resign from her teaching position to attend [Wexcombe College](../codex/places.md#wexcombe-college), Annetta and her fellow students are deeply dismayed to lose her as their teacher.

_Sources: [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P19](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0019), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P15](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0015), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P26](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0026), +2 more_
